name: Multilabeled Bengali Sentiment and Emotion Classification Dataset
description: A large-scale multi-label corpus consisting of 40,811 user-generated Bengali social media texts, annotated simultaneously with sentiment polarity (positive, negative, neutral) and discrete emotional categories (anger, disgust, fear, joy, sadness, surprise) to advance fine-grained affective computing.
